basic_info.description: Welcome to 2124 18th Avenue - A Classic San Francisco Gem in the Heart of the Sunset District.  Situated in the highly sought-after Inner Parkside neighborhood, this charming residence perfectly blends timeless character with modern comfort. Beautiful period details enhance the home's original appeal, adding warmth and sophistication throughout. The main level features a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, creating a welcoming atmosphere ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers generously sized bedrooms and a split bathroom for added convenience. On the lower level, you'll find a versatile bonus space and a large garage with abundant storage and exciting potential for future expansion (buyer to verify). The deep, landscaped backyard is a peaceful retreat perfect for gardening, outdoor dining, or simply unwinding. Just steps from Taraval Street, MUNI transportation, local parks, and top-rated schools, this home offers unbeatable convenience in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods. Don't miss the opportunity to own a classic San Francisco home in one of the city's most desirable locations.
